note: Listed-parent chains, verified once and reused for every facility. Listing evidence is the issuer's own regulatory record (SEC company submissions API for US filers; exchange data for others). 'relationship_basis' states what the operator directory proves; it never proves property ownership.

equinix.annual_report_ownership_note: FY2025 10-K Item 2 shows owned vs leased only per metro (a metro may contain both), so ownership of an individual IBX is not established from it.
equinix.relationship_basis: Facility listed in the operator's official data-center directory: operating relationship.

digitalrealty.annual_report_ownership_note: FY2025 10-K Schedule III aggregates properties by metro (building counts), not by facility; consolidated and joint-venture holdings are not separated per site in the directory.
digitalrealty.relationship_basis: Facility listed in the REIT's official data-center directory: operating relationship (per-site ownership vs JV vs lease not established).

coresite.relationship_basis: Facility listed in the official CoreSite directory; CoreSite is a subsidiary of American Tower (indirect corporate ownership of the operator).

nextdc.relationship_basis: Facility listed in the operator's official directory: operating/development relationship.

cyrusone.reason: Privately held (KKR and Global Infrastructure Partners); no listed common-equity parent. Facilities recorded as rejected for listed-exposure purposes.
